headline: Sagar-Runi murder case gets new clue, three more suspects identified
summary: The long-unresolved murder case of journalist couple Sagar Sarowar and Meherun Runi has seen a significant development with new leads emerging. This could bring a breakthrough in the decade-old investigation.
details: The long-standing murder case of journalist couple Sagar Sarowar and Meherun Runi has seen a significant development. Investigators have reportedly uncovered a new clue and identified three additional suspects in connection with the crime.

This breakthrough comes years after the brutal killing of the couple in their Dhaka residence in February 2012. The case has remained largely unsolved, drawing widespread public attention and calls for justice.

The new suspects and evidence are expected to provide crucial insights into the motive and perpetrators behind the double murder. Authorities are are now pursuing these leads to advance the investigation.
The identification of new suspects offers renewed hope for the victims' families and the public that the truth will finally emerge. Further details are anticipated as the investigation progresses.

headline_marked: [[Five children drown]] in Chapainawabganj river while bathing
headline: Five children drown in Chapainawabganj river while bathing
summary: Five young girls tragically lost their lives after drowning in a branch of the Padma River in Chapainawabganj Sadar upazila. The incident occurred on Friday afternoon as they were bathing together.
details: Five young girls tragically drowned in the Mora River, a branch of the Padma, in Char Chakla village under Debinagar Union, Chapainawabganj Sadar upazila. The heartbreaking incident occurred on Friday afternoon during Juma prayers.

The deceased were identified as Sumaiya (10) and Ariba (8), daughters of Md Masud; Sumaiya (12) and Suraiya (9), daughters of Md Nizam Uddin; and Sharifa (11), daughter of Md Shariful Islam. All the children were residents of Char Chakla village.

Police and eyewitnesses reported that the five girls went to bathe in the river near their homes. When one child began to sink, the others rushed to save her, but in a tragic chain of events, all five were quickly submerged in the deep water.

Local residents later recovered their lifeless bodies from the river. Debinagar Union Parishad Chairman Md Hafizur Rahman stated that such a tragic loss of multiple children at once is unprecedented in the area, leaving the entire village in profound mourning.

Chapainawabganj Additional Superintendent of Police ANM Wasim Firoz confirmed the incident, with police deployed to the scene. Sadar Upazila Nirbahi Officer Maruf Afzal Rajon expressed condolences and announced initial financial aid for burial, with further assistance planned for the families.
Family sources confirmed that the bodies of the five children would be laid to rest in the local graveyard after Maghrib prayers at 7 PM on Friday.

Five young girls tragically drowned in the Mora River, a branch of the Padma, in Char Chakla village under Debinagar Union, Chapainawabganj Sadar upazila. The heartbreaking incident occurred on Friday afternoon during Juma prayers.

The deceased were identified as Sumaiya (10) and Ariba (8), daughters of Md Masud; Sumaiya (12) and Suraiya (9), daughters of Md Nizam Uddin; and Sharifa (11), daughter of Md Shariful Islam. All the children were residents of Char Chakla village.

Police and eyewitnesses reported that the five girls went to bathe in the river near their homes. When one child began to sink, the others rushed to save her, but in a tragic chain of events, all five were quickly submerged in the deep water.

Local residents later recovered their lifeless bodies from the river. Debinagar Union Parishad Chairman Md Hafizur Rahman stated that such a tragic loss of multiple children at once is unprecedented in the area, leaving the entire village in profound mourning.

Chapainawabganj Additional Superintendent of Police ANM Wasim Firoz confirmed the incident, with police deployed to the scene. Sadar Upazila Nirbahi Officer Maruf Afzal Rajon expressed condolences and announced initial financial aid for burial, with further assistance planned for the families.
